svg.title: A config error costs a follower one tick, not the stream
svg.desc: Each poll tick reads the configuration through the shared quota-rate reader on its way to the stream cursor. When the layer validates, the tick derives its baseline and prints its rows. When the layer does not validate — a key a merge landed that the running schema rejects — the base revision raises out of the loop and the pane ends. At head the reader returns the empty, all-unpriced reading, so the tick still derives its baseline and prints its rows, and a config error the reader does not cover is caught by the loop, printed once as a single dim deferral line, and retried on the next tick. Once the layer validates again the deferral flag clears and delivery continues, so a misconfigured file costs the pane one tick rather than the whole arming.
svg.text: poll tick
baseline = watch_stream_cursor(project)
does flight.resolve() validate?
the shared reader asks once per tick, for every live run
yes — layer reads
derive the baseline, print rows
rates priced; delivery continues
no — the layer will not validate
is the error the reader covers?
the reader returns the empty, all-unpriced map
yes — degrade
baseline still printed
the cost drops to “unpriced”; the row does not
no — it escapes the reader
print ONE dim deferral line
“deferred a tick: the flight configuration could not be read …”
once per contiguous deferral, never once per tick
base: the raise leaves the loop
the pane ends — for a file the follower cannot repair
head: retry on the next tick
config validates again → delivery resumes
The declared mutation restores the reader’s raise: the per-tick read then never stops raising, the pane never delivers, and both arms go red.
